scope: Second registration of the formal relative-read gate, after two materializer trims. Diagnostic/test-only; the gate rule is unchanged from the first registration.

source.head: 09a5b53a
source.note: working tree carries the two trims described below; the tree is not committed until the measurement passes

trims: compare before assigning FrameSnapshot object materialAssetId (an equal assignment is a semantic no-op)

replace the per-object full id comparison with a length comparison, keeping the exact comparison for the first object of every frame; the layout stamp remains the authority that ties the layout to the runtime layout
protocol: exactly the first registration: 3 windows x 3 pairs, 600 s between windows, 3 s between pairs, alternating first arm, median of three read blocks per process, ratio B/A
decision: whole-group paired 95% interval upper bound <= 1.10 passes, lower > 1.10 is over, otherwise inconclusive

amendments.why: the source was clang-formatted after the first build, so the binary was rebuilt and its hash re-recorded before any measurement of this registration
